Job no: 943873

Work type: Full time

Located in: Adelaide CBD

Central Adelaide Local Health Network (CALHN)

The Royal Adelaide Hospital 

Salary ASO-4 $79,432 - $83,266 p.a. + super + salary packaging

Full-time temporary up to 31-7-27 

About CALHN
At Central Adelaide (CALHN), we're shaping the future of health through excellence in clinical care, research, and innovation. As South Australia's largest health network, we deliver exceptional, safe and connected healthcare - for our patients, our community, and our people.

With more than 17,000 dedicated employees, every day at CALHN presents an opportunity to make a real impact-not because it's expected, but because our values guide us to be our best. Find out more about CALHN sites and services, our stories and the opportunities to be part of CALHN.

About the Role

Join the TMO Unit and keep our junior doctor workforce running smoothly. You'll manage a medical admin portfolio, support safe rosters and recruitment, build trusted relationships and ensure TMOs across CALHN feel supported from start to finish.

- Coordinate TMO recruitment, allocation and rotations
- Manage rosters, leave and workforce data
- Monitor safe hours under SA Health EA
- Support IMG processes and compliance with AHPRA
- Liaise with leaders, HR and partners like SA MET and unions

About You

You're a calm, capable admin professional who thrives on detail, people and pace, and knows how to keep complex services running smoothly.

- Work independently, use judgement and stay on track with minimal direction
- Communicate clearly with leaders, teams and external partners
- Manage data, documents and systems with care and strict privacy
- Juggle priorities, meet deadlines and stay steady under pressure
- Use Microsoft tools to support rosters, reports and client service

Why You'll Love It Here - CALHN benefits that matter
We know that a great career is about more than just the work you do, it's also about the support you receive. At CALHN, you'll enjoy :

Salary packaging - up to $9,010 for living expenses + $2,650 for meals & entertainment + pre-tax super & novated lease options

Safe connections - be part of a culture of safety and connectivity, focusing on outcomes and continuous improvements

Recognition & growth - celebrate success and explore opportunities across CALHN's many sites

Flexible work options - speak to us about flexibility options for this role to suit your lifestyle

Paid leave - with leave loading for rest and recharge

Health & fitness perks - discounted access to Fitness Passport & free flu vaccinations

Wellbeing support - Employee Assistance Program for you & your family

Diversity & Inclusion
We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and supported. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disabilities, culturally diverse backgrounds, and LGBTQIA+ communities.

Join Above Benchmark: Become a Professional Mystery Shopper!


Are you ready to be the eyes and ears for Australia’s favourite Mystery Shopping provider?

At Above Benchmark, we live and breathe Mystery Shopping. We are aligned with the vision of having the happiest clients and the happiest mystery shoppers—we don’t want to be the biggest, we want to be the best. We are looking for highly motivated, detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Professional Mystery Shoppers.

This is a flexible and critical role where you provide essential, objective feedback that helps our clients achieve excellence. Our shoppers come from all walks of life, to better represent the customer base of our clients in a variety of businesses like shops, cafes, fast food restaurants, beauty clinics, pharmacies and even vets. 


Why Become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments. You don’t need prior experience, provided you have the skills and tech listed below. We include detailed instructions for every project, to make sure you know what to expect. 

The ideal candidate will possess:
* Exceptional Attention to Detail: The ability to observe, recall, and accurately report on specific service and environment criteria. We deal only in facts, so accuracy is paramount.
* Strong Communication Skills: Excellent written communication skills to accurately and professionally document experiences and articulate feedback. Verbal communication is essential for in-person visits or phone call surveys, so you must be easily understood.
* Technologically Confident: Comfortable using technology, including a reliable mobile phone and computer (or laptop/tablet) with stable internet and email access for receiving assignments and submitting reports.
* Reliability and Compliance: A proven ability to read, understand, and meticulously follow detailed instructions and deadlines for every assignment. Some surveys require photos or receipts to be uploaded as proof. 


How much will you get paid?

We pay our Mystery Shoppers for every completed assignment—we don’t ask them to work for freebies or to consider a free meal as their payment.

Payment Structure: Mystery Shop payments are different for each assignment and are based on the time and effort needed. Typically, payments range from $20-$50 (sometimes more) for onsite visits and $15-$30 for phone calls.

Reimbursements: Meals and purchases are in addition to the payment. If a purchase is required, Mystery Shoppers use their own money, then are paid back with their survey payment. All information provided before you accept an assignment.

Fast Payments: At Above Benchmark, we are incredibly proud to have the fastest Mystery Shopper payments in the country. Payments are processed weekly into the nominated bank account. We do not pay in vouchers, freebies, or PayPal.

If you are passionate about customer service, enjoy independent work, and meet the requirements above, we encourage you to apply and help us ensure all our clients deliver a truly Above Benchmark experience!


Where to find out more information?

If you’d like more information about what we do, please visit our website for more details and informative blogs. There you’ll find links to our social sites where you can read more about our business as well as testimonials and reviews from our Mystery Shoppers and clients. https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopping-jobs/


How do you apply?

Our confidential application form can be found here: https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopper-application/


We look forward to your application!

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Westmead Hospital

Fixed Term (12 months) 0.8FTE Postgraduate Fellow - Head and Neck Surgery

Department of Otolaryngology, Head & Neck Surgery (ENT)

APPLY HERE

Applications are invited from a suitably qualified Postgraduate Fellow for Fixed Term in the Western Sydney Local Health District. The position will be primarily located at Westmead Hospital within the Department of Otolaryngology, Head & Neck Surgery (ENT).

The position will be for a period of twelve months for the 2027 Clinical Year.

Appointees may be eligible for credentialing and privileging across all other facilities in the Western Sydney Local Health District.

Applicants expecting to be awarded fellowship within 6 months are eligible to apply.

Conditions of appointment are in accordance with the Staff Specialists (State) Award.

Essential Requirements for Appointment

1. Possess or be eligible for registration with the Medical Board of Australia with Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Surgeons in Otolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery, or equivalent, as provided for in the Staff Specialists (State) Award.

2. Sound clinical knowledge in Otolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery demonstrated through successful clinical practice in an environment appropriate to the requirements of the position.

3. Demonstrated interest in Head and Neck oncological surgery.

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
Selection Criteria

1. Qualifications and credentials required for core scope of practice in the specialty.

2. Evidence of additional qualifications, skills and-or experience required for specific scope of practice for the specialty, including logbook evidence confirming experience in Head and Neck Oncological Surgery.

3. Demonstrated skills and attitudes appropriate for practice as a Senior Medical Practitioner including:

Proven ability to work effectively and harmoniously with medical and other health services colleagues as part of a multi-disciplinary health care team.

Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with patients and colleagues.

Excellent organisational, supervision and collaboration skills with demonstrated ability to build respectful relationships.

Maintaining and developing knowledge, skills and professional performance to the level required for contemporary practice.

Experience and involvement in quality assurance activities and translation of research into practice to improve patient safety and quality.

4. Demonstrated ability to manage time and resources efficiently and contributing to the effectiveness and efficiency of the health care system.

5. Demonstrated aptitude for clinical leadership which is evidenced by:

Systems thinking and risk-taking aptitude.

Commitment to self -care and personal development.

Capacity to maintain personal integrity, tolerate stress and demonstrate resilience.

Commitment to building relationships, leading, and developing others.

Join Above Benchmark: Become a Professional Mystery Shopper!


Are you ready to be the eyes and ears for Australia’s favourite Mystery Shopping provider?

At Above Benchmark, we live and breathe Mystery Shopping. We are aligned with the vision of having the happiest clients and the happiest mystery shoppers—we don’t want to be the biggest, we want to be the best. We are looking for highly motivated, detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Professional Mystery Shoppers.

This is a flexible and critical role where you provide essential, objective feedback that helps our clients achieve excellence. Our shoppers come from all walks of life, to better represent the customer base of our clients in a variety of businesses like shops, cafes, fast food restaurants, beauty clinics, pharmacies and even vets. 


Why Become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments. You don’t need prior experience, provided you have the skills and tech listed below. We include detailed instructions for every project, to make sure you know what to expect. 

The ideal candidate will possess:
* Exceptional Attention to Detail: The ability to observe, recall, and accurately report on specific service and environment criteria. We deal only in facts, so accuracy is paramount.
* Strong Communication Skills: Excellent written communication skills to accurately and professionally document experiences and articulate feedback. Verbal communication is essential for in-person visits or phone call surveys, so you must be easily understood.
* Technologically Confident: Comfortable using technology, including a reliable mobile phone and computer (or laptop/tablet) with stable internet and email access for receiving assignments and submitting reports.
* Reliability and Compliance: A proven ability to read, understand, and meticulously follow detailed instructions and deadlines for every assignment. Some surveys require photos or receipts to be uploaded as proof. 


How much will you get paid?

We pay our Mystery Shoppers for every completed assignment—we don’t ask them to work for freebies or to consider a free meal as their payment.

Payment Structure: Mystery Shop payments are different for each assignment and are based on the time and effort needed. Typically, payments range from $20-$50 (sometimes more) for onsite visits and $15-$30 for phone calls.

Reimbursements: Meals and purchases are in addition to the payment. If a purchase is required, Mystery Shoppers use their own money, then are paid back with their survey payment. All information provided before you accept an assignment.

Fast Payments: At Above Benchmark, we are incredibly proud to have the fastest Mystery Shopper payments in the country. Payments are processed weekly into the nominated bank account. We do not pay in vouchers, freebies, or PayPal.

If you are passionate about customer service, enjoy independent work, and meet the requirements above, we encourage you to apply and help us ensure all our clients deliver a truly Above Benchmark experience!


Where to find out more information?

If you’d like more information about what we do, please visit our website for more details and informative blogs. There you’ll find links to our social sites where you can read more about our business as well as testimonials and reviews from our Mystery Shoppers and clients. https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopping-jobs/


How do you apply?

Our confidential application form can be found here: https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopper-application/


We look forward to your application!

We are looking for a Mystery Shopper who owns a dog or cat and can take their pet to a vet for a consultation. Payment for this survey is $30, PLUS you will be reimbursed for the consult fee up to $130. These are great surveys for pet owners and are especially suitable for annual vaccinations or a general health check-up.  

You will be provided instructions and a survey form for each job, then simply visit the target client and act just like a regular customer, while observing everything. Upon completion, you log into our Mystery Shopping software and enter the results including any required photos and receipts.   
  

TO JOIN OUR TEAM YOU WILL NEED;  

  • regular and reliable access to the internet, email and a ideally a printer  

  • an excellent memory and report writing skills  

  • confidence to role-play and improvise  

  • fantastic communication skills; verbal and written  

  • confidence in computers/smartphones, etc.

Full instructions are provided along with any specific requirements, deadlines and full details if you need to purchase something.

Mystery Shop payments range from $15 - $30 for phone calls and $20 -$50 for onsite visits. Meals and purchases are in addition to the mystery shop payment. Thank you for considering our Mystery Shopping position. We look forward to your application!

Join Above Benchmark: Become a Professional Mystery Shopper!


Are you ready to be the eyes and ears for Australia’s favourite Mystery Shopping provider?

At Above Benchmark, we live and breathe Mystery Shopping. We are aligned with the vision of having the happiest clients and the happiest mystery shoppers—we don’t want to be the biggest, we want to be the best. We are looking for highly motivated, detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Professional Mystery Shoppers.

This is a flexible and critical role where you provide essential, objective feedback that helps our clients achieve excellence. Our shoppers come from all walks of life, to better represent the customer base of our clients in a variety of businesses like shops, cafes, fast food restaurants, beauty clinics, pharmacies and even vets. 


Why Become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments. You don’t need prior experience, provided you have the skills and tech listed below. We include detailed instructions for every project, to make sure you know what to expect. 

The ideal candidate will possess:
* Exceptional Attention to Detail: The ability to observe, recall, and accurately report on specific service and environment criteria. We deal only in facts, so accuracy is paramount.
* Strong Communication Skills: Excellent written communication skills to accurately and professionally document experiences and articulate feedback. Verbal communication is essential for in-person visits or phone call surveys, so you must be easily understood.
* Technologically Confident: Comfortable using technology, including a reliable mobile phone and computer (or laptop/tablet) with stable internet and email access for receiving assignments and submitting reports.
* Reliability and Compliance: A proven ability to read, understand, and meticulously follow detailed instructions and deadlines for every assignment. Some surveys require photos or receipts to be uploaded as proof. 


How much will you get paid?

We pay our Mystery Shoppers for every completed assignment—we don’t ask them to work for freebies or to consider a free meal as their payment.

Payment Structure: Mystery Shop payments are different for each assignment and are based on the time and effort needed. Typically, payments range from $20-$50 (sometimes more) for onsite visits and $15-$30 for phone calls.

Reimbursements: Meals and purchases are in addition to the payment. If a purchase is required, Mystery Shoppers use their own money, then are paid back with their survey payment. All information provided before you accept an assignment.

Fast Payments: At Above Benchmark, we are incredibly proud to have the fastest Mystery Shopper payments in the country. Payments are processed weekly into the nominated bank account. We do not pay in vouchers, freebies, or PayPal.

If you are passionate about customer service, enjoy independent work, and meet the requirements above, we encourage you to apply and help us ensure all our clients deliver a truly Above Benchmark experience!


Where to find out more information?

If you’d like more information about what we do, please visit our website for more details and informative blogs. There you’ll find links to our social sites where you can read more about our business as well as testimonials and reviews from our Mystery Shoppers and clients. https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopping-jobs/


How do you apply?

Our confidential application form can be found here: https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopper-application/


We look forward to your application!

Join Above Benchmark: Become a Professional Mystery Shopper!


Are you ready to be the eyes and ears for Australia’s favourite Mystery Shopping provider?

At Above Benchmark, we live and breathe Mystery Shopping. We are aligned with the vision of having the happiest clients and the happiest mystery shoppers—we don’t want to be the biggest, we want to be the best. We are looking for highly motivated, detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Professional Mystery Shoppers.

This is a flexible and critical role where you provide essential, objective feedback that helps our clients achieve excellence. Our shoppers come from all walks of life, to better represent the customer base of our clients in a variety of businesses like shops, cafes, fast food restaurants, beauty clinics, pharmacies and even vets. 


Why Become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments. You don’t need prior experience, provided you have the skills and tech listed below. We include detailed instructions for every project, to make sure you know what to expect. 

The ideal candidate will possess:
* Exceptional Attention to Detail: The ability to observe, recall, and accurately report on specific service and environment criteria. We deal only in facts, so accuracy is paramount.
* Strong Communication Skills: Excellent written communication skills to accurately and professionally document experiences and articulate feedback. Verbal communication is essential for in-person visits or phone call surveys, so you must be easily understood.
* Technologically Confident: Comfortable using technology, including a reliable mobile phone and computer (or laptop/tablet) with stable internet and email access for receiving assignments and submitting reports.
* Reliability and Compliance: A proven ability to read, understand, and meticulously follow detailed instructions and deadlines for every assignment. Some surveys require photos or receipts to be uploaded as proof. 


How much will you get paid?

We pay our Mystery Shoppers for every completed assignment—we don’t ask them to work for freebies or to consider a free meal as their payment.

Payment Structure: Mystery Shop payments are different for each assignment and are based on the time and effort needed. Typically, payments range from $20-$50 (sometimes more) for onsite visits and $15-$30 for phone calls.

Reimbursements: Meals and purchases are in addition to the payment. If a purchase is required, Mystery Shoppers use their own money, then are paid back with their survey payment. All information provided before you accept an assignment.

Fast Payments: At Above Benchmark, we are incredibly proud to have the fastest Mystery Shopper payments in the country. Payments are processed weekly into the nominated bank account. We do not pay in vouchers, freebies, or PayPal.

If you are passionate about customer service, enjoy independent work, and meet the requirements above, we encourage you to apply and help us ensure all our clients deliver a truly Above Benchmark experience!


Where to find out more information?

If you’d like more information about what we do, please visit our website for more details and informative blogs. There you’ll find links to our social sites where you can read more about our business as well as testimonials and reviews from our Mystery Shoppers and clients. https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopping-jobs/


How do you apply?

Our confidential application form can be found here: https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopper-application/


We look forward to your application!

How much will you get paid?

Reimbursements: Meals and purchases are in addition to the payment. If a purchase is required, Mystery Shoppers use their own money, then are paid back with their survey payment. All information provided before you accept an assignment.

Fast Payments: At Above Benchmark, we are incredibly proud to have the fastest Mystery Shopper payments in the country. Payments are processed weekly into the nominated bank account. We do not pay in vouchers, freebies, or PayPal.

If you are passionate about customer service, enjoy independent work, and meet the requirements above, we encourage you to apply and help us ensure all our clients deliver a truly Above Benchmark experience!
